title: New optimal linear codes over $\ZZ_4$
summary: In this work, we present novel approaches for constructing linear codes over $\ZZ_4$ from the known ones. We succeeded in obtaining new linear codes, many of which are optimal. In particular, we found all optimal codes for $k_1=2,~k_2=0$ and many optimal codes for $k_1=3,~k_2=0.$
